prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website direction comp, 16:10 landscape, first viewport plus a visible beginning of the second section
Primary request: Design a bold, production-grade homepage comp for the Brazilian ecommerce brand "Medicina Sagrada" using the visual world "Atlas das Confluências". This is a persuasive ecommerce interface, not a poster and not a moodboard.
Structure: a slim dark-green navigation bar with the existing brand name at left, compact menu links "Rapé", "Sananga", "Artesanato", "Etnias", "Nossa história", and search/cart controls; an asymmetric hero occupying about 70% of the viewport; the left side carries a concise offer and a highly visible catalog CTA; the right side is a layered cartographic composition with an Amazon river aerial landscape plate, restrained route lines, origin coordinates, and small unlabeled rapé and sananga product objects. The lower edge reveals the start of section two: seven large circular origin portals in one horizontal rhythm, labeled "Huni Kuin", "Shawãdawa", "Kuntanawa", "Nukini", "Yawanawa", "Apurinã", "Shanenawa", plus a narrow right-side shortcut "VER TODAS AS ETNIAS →".
Exact hero text: "Medicinas indígenas originais, direto da floresta."
Exact supporting text: "Conheça produtos de diferentes povos e histórias de origem."
Exact CTA: "ENTRAR NO CATÁLOGO"
Visual system: hydrographic atlas, river navigation chart, provenance seals, editorial route annotations, contemporary Brazilian design, visually confident and human.
Palette: dominant #17401D deep green, region-sized fields of #248C34 green, primary CTA #EF492B orange, deep red #A3250F for route markers, warm neutral #F4F0E6.
Typography: distinctive sturdy contemporary grotesk display with a legible humanist sans for body; no high-contrast editorial serif.
Materials/textures: subtle cartographic paper grain, thin route lines, flat color fields, documentary landscape photography.
Composition: strong readable hierarchy, generous but intentional negative space, clear ecommerce action in the first five seconds, no generic centered hero, no card grid in the hero.
Image ethics: do not invent Indigenous portraits, body paint, clothing, symbols, or tribal patterns. The seven circles use abstract documentary placeholders combining landscape and craft detail only; they will later be replaced with real authorized photography.
Constraints: no fabricated reviews, prices, certifications, badges, health claims, discounts, or community-impact numbers. No mystical smoke, mandalas, generic leaves, gold luxury styling, beige wellness template, glassmorphism, gradients, watermarks, browser chrome, device frame, or explanatory annotations outside the website itself. Render as a polished website screen with crisp UI text.
